title: Somewhere Over Nashville
description:
Enjoy stunning downtown skyline views right from the living room, where calming, thoughtfully designed decor creates the perfect space to relax and recharge before a night out. Perched at the top of the hill as a private end unit, this professionally styled retreat is ideal for unforgettable group stays in Nashville.

Prime Location

Only 2.6 miles to Broadway
2 miles to Nissan Stadium 
2.5 miles to Germantown 
5 minutes to Downtown Nashville
10 minutes to The Gulch 
15 minutes to BNA Airport

The space
Sleeping arrangements include 1 King bed, 2 Queen Murphy beds, and a triple twin bunk bed.

The two queen beds are murphy beds. They are located in an open, studio-style space on the second floor (no enclosed walls), creating a shared and spacious sleeping area.

Please note there are 17 steps between the first and second floors.
